## HTML Code Link

Setting `html-link: true` in the `colab:` block adds an **Open in Colab** link to the HTML page sidebar (under "Code Links"), linking to the sibling `.ipynb` output file:

```yaml
colab:
  gh-user: "username"
  gh-repo: "reponame"
  html-link: true
```

The link visible in the sidebar of this page was added via that option.

## Python Example

This example demonstrates how the `colab` extension adds a setup cell when rendering to an `.ipynb` notebook for use in Google Colab. The setup cell (which installs dependencies) only appears in the notebook output — not in this HTML page.

```{python}
#| echo: true
#| eval: false
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

x = np.linspace(0, 2 * np.pi, 100)
plt.plot(x, np.sin(x))
plt.title("Sine Wave")
plt.show()
```

## What to Expect

When you open the rendered `.ipynb` in Google Colab, the first cell will be:

```python
# Install required packages
!pip install matplotlib numpy
```

This cell is injected automatically from the `setup-cells: python:` block in the document's YAML header. It does **not** appear in any other output format (e.g. this HTML page).
